title: Every is Partnering with Adam Derry's Blue Horizon Legal to Provide Trusted Legal Services to Founders, Startups, and Investors
summary: The Every and Blue Horizon Legal partnership will provide Every customers with access to one of the industry’s leading boutique firms, ensuring focused, hands-on support whether you’ve just raised your seed round or are planning for M&A.
body_markdown:
Building a startup means closely managing where every dollar and hour goes. Great founders are always keeping an eye out for ways to extend their runway. But there are some costs worth paying.


Many companies go too long without consulting a lawyer in an effort to save money, only to end up creating a mess that costs far more to clean up later. Scenarios like unvested cofounder equity, missing IP assignments, and handshake equity promises can easily snowball into time-consuming and expensive negotiations without proper legal guidance.


That’s why Every is partnering with[Blue Horizon Legal](https://bluehorizonlegal.com/) , a leading law firm that provides trusted legal services to founders, startups, and investors.


## Introducing Every + Blue Horizon Legal


The Every and Blue Horizon Legal partnership will provide Every customers with access to one of the industry’s leading boutique firms, ensuring focused, hands-on support whether you’ve just raised your seed round or are planning for M&A. Blue Horizon clients, meanwhile, can start using Every’s best-in-class back office solutions on preferred terms, covering everything from payroll to taxes.


With support across both legal and finance operations, Blue Horizon and Every help founders stay laser-focused on growth without stumbling into any back-office pitfalls.


"It's good to engage a lawyer early, as opposed to waiting,”[Adam Derry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adam-derry-366b5a20/) , founder of Blue Horizon Legal, explains. “It doesn't mean you need to use them all the time, but it’s great to have one to answer questions and sanity-check strategic decisions."


## Inside Blue Horizon Legal: Meet Adam Derry


Adam Derry has spent nearly 15 years advising startups, both in-house and at leading firms. After graduating from Harvard Law School, Adam spent eight years at[Fenwick & West](https://www.fenwick.com/) , working on major deals for the leading tech companies and investors. Since then he has spent time in-house as the General Counsel of a startup and at a mid-sized startup firm.


Having worked on 500+ venture deals, Adam launched Blue Horizon Legal in 2024 with the goal of providing founders, startups, and investors with the quality and insight you’d expect from Silicon Valley’s leading law firms at a fraction of the cost. Since launching, Blue Horizon has been listed in Chambers USA's startups and emerging companies spotlight and supported over 100 startups.


## What Services Does Blue Horizon Legal Provide?


Blue Horizon offers services for every stage of the startup journey. Early-stage companies benefit from guidance on formation and incorporation. Growing companies can raise questions related to venture financing (SAFEs, convertible notes, priced seed, Series A/B), commercial contracts, and equity and employment matters, like option grants, stock, hiring and firing. Scaling companies can work with Blue Horizon on M&A, both on the buying and selling side.


In addition to supporting these pivotal moments, Blue Horizon also offers ongoing outside general counsel work, assisting with day-to-day questions, board and stockholder matters, and strategic calls.


By addressing these legal questions as companies are growing, Blue Horizon helps structure companies so they’re fundable and built to scale.


If you’re interested in Blue Horizon Legal, you can learn more about their services[here](https://www.every.io/partners/blue-horizon-legal?) .
